searchText: Having to support two versions of the events API is annoying, but having both `xxx` and `versioned_xxx` topics is not friendly UX. Since we will probably move more and more types into `versioned_xxx` over time, I would prefer to just have a v2 endpoint

excerpts.author: radekkapka
excerpts.content: Having to support two versions of the events API is annoying, but having both `xxx` and `versioned_xxx` topics is not friendly UX. Since we will probably move more and more types into `versioned_xxx` over time, I would prefer to just have a v2 endpoint
